name: Camera Pose Optimization via SE(3) Decomposition
definition: Non-parametric optimization of camera poses (SE(3) transformations) during training by decomposing the transformation matrix into manageable components to avoid manifold escape issues (e.g., R*R^T != I).
summary: Camera Pose Optimization via SE(3) Decomposition stabilizes generative radiance field training by optimizing sine and cosine rotation components instead of Euler angles, preventing invalid rotation matrices.
